sites.name: Blackthorn highlands (headquarters)
sites.anchor: Route 45 and Route 44, between Blackthorn City and Dark Cave
game_facts: Route 45 is a mountain road with a river; Dark Cave opens onto it (cartridge)
Ice Path links Blackthorn to Mahogany (cartridge)
Dragon's Den, the dragon clan's shrine, sits behind Blackthorn Gym (cartridge)
Route 44 has a lake and grass (cartridge)
sites.why: Home region of three chapters (Crystal, HeartGold, SoulSilver). One stretch of road gives mountains, a cave system, a river, real ice and a sacred site.
alternatives: Lake of Rage and Route 43 (a huge lake and open grassland)
Mt. Silver and Route 28 (the endgame mountain, snow at the summit in HGSS)
sites.heritage: Route 34 Day-Care in Goldenrod, Johto's breeding house (cartridge)

sites.name: Sevii Islands estate
game_facts: Mt. Ember volcano and the Ember Spa hot spring on Kindle Road, One Island (cartridge)
Icefall Cave and a Day-Care on Four Island (cartridge)
Sevault Canyon and the Tanoby Ruins on Seven Island (cartridge)
Seel and Dewgong live in Icefall Cave (cartridge encounter data)
sites.why: An archipelago that already has almost every terrain, a volcano with a hot spring, a berry forest and its own Day-Care. FireRed's chapter ends here.

sites.name: Route 117 gardens and Lavaridge springs
sites.anchor: Route 117 (Verdanturf) with a second parcel at Lavaridge Town and Route 112
game_facts: The Hoenn Day-Care is on Route 117, among flower beds and a pond (cartridge)
Lavaridge Town has hot springs below Mt. Chimney (cartridge)

sites.name: Resort Area villa and the Battle Zone
sites.anchor: Platinum's Resort Area villa, with land across the Battle Zone (Routes 225-230, Stark Mountain)
game_facts: The Villa in the Resort Area can be bought in Platinum (believed: 50,000,000 Pokédollars; verify)
Stark Mountain is a volcano in the Battle Zone (cartridge)
Solaceon Town has Sinnoh's Day-Care and the Solaceon Ruins (cartridge)

alternatives: Route 217 and Lake Acuity snowfields for cold-climate residents

glasshouse.name: The Glasshouse
glasshouse.idea: One building where eggs and plants share everything. Blackthorn sits against the Ice Path, so both need heat, and the heat comes from Pokémon. A Magcargo hearth at the core keeps the eggs warm; the greenhouse rings wrap around it and live on the same heat. Ampharos lights both through the winter. Eggs hatch by being walked, so the walk that hatches them runs through the crop rows: the egg walk is the harvest walk.

questions.question: Which satellite: the Sevii Islands or the Battle Zone?
questions.why: Blackthorn has no volcano and no sea. Lapras needs the sea; both Infernape and the Infernape stud need volcanic ground. Either site covers both.
options: Sevii Islands (Kanto): Mt. Ember, the Ember Spa, the open sea, Lapras's home region
Battle Zone (Sinnoh): Stark Mountain, the sea, Infernape's home region, Platinum's villa

questions.question: Confirm the D-038 reading: one stud per target line, a male who knows the whole egg-move set.
questions.why: The whole studbook is built on it: 9 studs and one Light Ball. The other reading keeps the last father in each chain instead.
options: Yes: a stud of each target line
No: keep the last father of each chain

questions.question: Approve W-016 (Meganium, the Glasshouse gardener) and W-017 (Miltank, the nursery's milk)?
questions.why: Two of the Glasshouse's jobs are story-only until a world record backs them.
questions.blocks: two open jobs in the Glasshouse

questions.question: The Day-Care preserve: who gets invited, and what do clients' Pokémon experience there?
questions.why: It's the one open part of the ranch (D-040). Not urgent.

questions.question: The companions' genders.
questions.why: They decide who can father and who can mother. Until then every parent reads "could be". If HeartGold Tyranitar is male and knows Dragon Dance and Outrage, he's already the Tyranitar stud.
questions.blocks: who sires and who carries in every cross

questions.question: Which outside fathers become part of the story?
questions.why: Seven crosses borrow a father from outside the journey: Nuzleaf (Extrasensory), Kingdra (Dragon Dance), Muk (Disable), Heracross (Counter), Azumarill (Aqua Ring), Dewgong (Ice Shard) and Bellossom (Leaf Storm, Sleep Powder). Under D-038 they go home after.
questions.blocks: names and stories for 7 borrowed fathers

decisions.title: Game film: Showdown replays, read exactly, are how the project learns real play.
Bulbapedia answers the open questions from its page source, read exactly first; the games' Pokédex backs or doesn't back what videos claim.
The ladder's monthly numbers fill what film can't show.
The engine is held to outside references, and a wrong line in a report becomes a check.
Blackthorn gets its Canon DB Sheet, with a lineage tracker and an Apps Script.
Blackthorn HQ: one web app over the Sheet, the engines and the documents.
The app is a lab: the engines you tinker with run in the browser, held to Python by tests.
The battle engine runs live in the app, every section of the scouting file with it.
The numbers decide, and the app has to work where it's deployed.
